49-670132011.title: ACCOUNTANT, CERTIFIED PUBLIC
49-670132011.description: Examine, analyze, and interpret accounting records for the purpose of giving advice or preparing statements. Install or advise on systems of recording costs or other financial and budgetary data.
49-670132011.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-78.title: Enrolled Actuary
00-78.description: Enrolled Actuaries meet experience requirements and pass an examination. EAs are experts on the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA). The EA designation is awarded by the Joint Board for the Enrollment of Actuaries, located at the Internal Revenue Service, U.S. Department of the Treasury. Renewal every 3 years requires continuing actuarial education and other professional development activities. For detailed information, see http://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-utl/20cfr901.pdf or http://www.irs.gov/taxpros/actuaries/index.html.
00-78.agency: U.S. Department of the Treasury · Joint Board for the Enrollment of Actuaries

49-670172199.title: PROFESSIONAL ENGINEER
49-670172199.description: Prepare, sign, seal and submit engineering plans and drawings to public authorities for approval, seal engineering work for public and private clients.
49-670172199.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-18.title: Air Traffic Control Tower Operator
00-18.description: Requirements to obtain an Air Traffic Control Tower Operator certificate include passing a written test. Besides the basic certificate, to act at any operating position, the individual must pass a practical test on control tower equipment and its use. To obtain a facility rating, the individual must have at least six months experience and pass another practical test. This certificate is valid until surrendered, suspended or revoked, although the individual must maintain current experience to work under the certificate. Detailed information can be found at web sites:http://www.faa.gov/licenses_certificates/airmen_certification/airmen_FAQ, http://www.natca.org/assets/Documents/mediacenter/controller_brochure.pdf, http://www2.faa.gov/careers/employment/atc.htm, and http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr65_00.html, parts 65.31-65.50.

00-12.title: Aircraft Mechanic - A & P
00-12.description: Aircraft mechanics are certified by the FAA with either an airframe (A) or powerplant (P) rating. Initial ratings require either completion of FAA Approved Aviation Maintenance Technician School or 18 months of work experience. Applicants must pass written, oral and practical exams. Thirty months of work experience is required for a combined Airframe & Powerplant (A & P) certificate. To obtain an inspector's authorization, a mechanic must have held an A & P certificate for at least 3 years. This certificate is valid until it is surrendered, suspended or revoked, but requires currency of experience or refresher training. For further information, go the web site of the Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS): http://umet-vets.dol.gov/airframe-mechanic.htm, http://www1.faa.gov/AVR/afs/mechanics.htm, and http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr65_00.html, parts 65.71-65.95.

00-16.title: Aircraft Repairer
00-16.description: To be eligible for a repairman certificate, a person must have the qualifications needed on the job. These qualifications may be obtained through 18 months of work experience or completion of formal training. Detailed information can be found on the web sites: http://www2.faa.gov/education/rlib/career.htm and http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr65_00.html, parts 65.101-65.105.

49-FAA000109.title: AIRCRAFT MECHANIC
49-FAA000109.description: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul aircraft engines and assemblies, such as hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
49-FAA000109.agency: Federal Aviation Administration · Flight Standards District Office

00-02.title: Airline Transport Pilot
00-02.description: To become certified (licensed) as an Airline Transport Pilot (ATP), an individual must have a Commercial Pilot certificate or equivalent with an instrument rating for airplane, helicopter, or powered-lift (glider). Air flight training and ground school as well as flight experience are requirements. They also must pass a strict physical examination and have 20/20 vision with or without glasses, good hearing, and no physical handicaps that could impair performance. They must pass a written test and a demonstration of flying ability. This license is valid until it is surrendered, suspended or revoked; but the pilot must have a current medical certificate. Detailed information can be found on the web sites: http://www.faa.gov/avr/afs/acs/61-65d.pdf and http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr61_00.html, parts 61.151-61.167.

00-08.title: Commercial Pilot
00-08.description: All pilots who are paid to transport passengers or cargo must have a Commercial Pilot's license with an instrument rating issued by the FAA. To qualify for this license, the applicant must be at least 18 years old and have at least 250 hours of flight experience. The time can be reduced through participation in certain flight school curricula approved by the FAA. The individual also must pass a strict physical examination and have 20/20 vision with or without glasses, good hearing, and no physical handicaps that could impair performance. Passing a written test and a demonstration of flying ability are required. This license is valid until it is surrendered, suspended or revoked; but the pilot must have a current medical certificate. Detailed information can be found on the web sites: http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr61_00.html, parts 61.121-61.133 and http://www.faa.gov/avr/afs/acs/61-65d.pdf.

00-15.title: Flight Engineer
00-15.description: To become certified as a Flight Engineer requires that the individual have either training or experience. Passing a written exam and a practical test and having a current medical certificate are also required. This certificate is valid until it is surrendered, suspended or revoked. Detailed information can be found on the web sites: http://umet-vets.dol.gov/flightengineer.htm and http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr63_00.html, parts 63.31-63.43.

00-77.title: Flight Instructor
00-77.description: To obtain certification as a Flight Instructor, the individual must hold either a Commercial Pilot or Airline Transport Pilot certificate with appropriate aircraft and instrument ratings. Training is required as well as experience in the type of aircraft being rated. This license is valid for 2 years and may be renewed by one of several options, such as passing a practical test, documenting student success, or taking a refresher course. More details can be found at web sites: http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr61_00.html, parts 61.181-61.199, www.faa.gov/avr/afs/acs/61-65d.pdf, and http://www.faa.gov/licenses_certificates/airmen_certification/airmen_FAQ.

00-20.title: Flight Navigator
00-20.description: To become certified as a Flight Navigator, the individual must be at least 21 years old and have a medical certificate. He or she must have both training in flight navigation and practical experience. Passing written and practical tests are required as well as having a current medical certificate. This certificate is valid until surrendered, suspended, or revoked. Detailed information can be found on the web site: http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr63_00.html, parts 63.51-63.61.

00-13.title: Ground Instructor
00-13.description: To obtain certification as a Ground Instructor, the individual must pass an aircraft navigation knowledge test and a test of the fundamentals of instructing, unless the person already is employed as a teacher or holds a teacher's certification. Detailed information can be found at web sites: http://www.faa.gov/licenses_certificates/airmen_certification/airmen_FAQ and http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr61_00.html, parts 61.211-61.217.

requirements.label: Certification
requirements.value: Certification my substitute for license requirements

00-06.title: Private Pilot
00-06.description: Obtaining a Private Pilot certificate (license) requires the individual to complete ground and flight training, have flight experience, obtain a medical certificate, and pass a written exam as well as a demonstration of flying ability. This license is valid until it is surrendered, suspended or revoked; but the pilot must have a current medical certificate. The FAA Advisory Circular, AC 61-12M, Student Pilot Guide, outlines general procedures for obtaining student and private pilot certificates. Detailed information can be found at web sites: http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr61_00.html, parts 61.102-61.117, and http://www.faa.gov/avr/afs/acs/61-65d.pdf.

49-FAA000110.title: AIRCRAFT PILOT - FLIGHT ENGINEER
49-FAA000110.description: Pilot and navigate the flight of multi-engine or single engine aircraft in regularly scheduled on or demand service for the transport of passengers and cargo. Requires Federal Air Transportation rating and certification in specific aircraft type used (large aircraft – commercial, smaller aircraft – private or recreational). Include aircraft instructors with similar certification.
49-FAA000110.agency: Federal Aviation Administration · Flight Standards District Office

49-670492098.title: ALARM SYSTEM INSTALLER
49-670492098.description: A burglar alarm installer is an individual engaged in the alarm business which includes any commercial activity involving the sale, wiring and equipment installation, maintenance, alteration, program, maintain and repair of security and fire alarm systems. A burglar alarm company agent is any individual employed within this state by a person engaged in the alarm business.
49-670492098.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-60.title: Medical Doctor
00-60.description: A ship's Medical Doctor is a staff officer and is required to obtain a Certificate of Registry (COR). To obtain a COR requires completing first aid and cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training within the past 12 months and meeting medical fitness standards. A medical doctor must also hold a valid license as a physician or surgeon issued within the United States. Further information can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, http://frwebgate.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/get-cfr.cgi?TITLE=46&PART=10&SUBPART=H&TYPE=TEXT, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-60.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-670291229.title: OSTEOPATHIC PHYSICIAN & SURGEON
49-670291229.description: An osteopathic physician and surgeon diagnoses and treats diseases of the human body with an emphasis on the importance of the muscular-skeletal system and in the maintenance and restorations of health.
49-670291229.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670291249.title: PHYSICIAN - SURGEONS
49-670291249.description: Physicians and surgeons diagnose, treat, and help prevent diseases, disorders of the body, and injuries that commonly occur in the general population.
49-670291249.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670171011.title: ARCHITECT
49-670171011.description: An architect provides professional services in planning and designing structures, such as private residences, office buildings, theaters, factories, and other structural property.
49-670171011.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-48.title: Second Assistant Engineer - Upper Level
00-48.description: To obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a Second Assistant Engineer - Upper Level, the applicant must, while holding a license as a Third Assistant Engineer, complete one of the following: 360 days of service as an Assistant Engineer; or a minimum of 180 days as an Assistant Engineer and 360 days as a Qualified Member of the Engine Department (QMED); or 360 days as Chief Engineer (Limited-Oceans). Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. This license is valid for 5 years and may be renewed through various options involving recent work experience, passing an open-book exercise, or completing a refresher training course. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-48.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-38.title: Second Mate - Upper Level
00-38.description: To obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a Second Mate Upper Level requires 360 days service as Officer in Charge of a Navigational Watch (OIC) on ocean steam or motor vessels while licensed as a Third Mate. Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. Detailed information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-38.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-670299091.title: ATHLETE TRAINER
49-670299091.description: The "practice of athletic training" means the application by a licensed and certified athletic trainer of principles and methods of: prevention of athletic injuries; recognition, evaluation, and assessment of athletic injuries and conditions; immediate care of athletic injuries, including common emergency medical situations; rehabilitation and reconditioning of athletic injuries; athletic training services administration and organization; and education of athletes.
49-670299091.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-400291181.title: AUDIOLOGIST
49-400291181.description: Assess, and treats persons with hearing and related disorders. Fit hearing aids, and provide auditory training. May perform research related to, hearing problems.
49-400291181.agency: Educator Licensing Division · Utah State Board of Education

49-670291181.title: AUDIOLOGIST
49-670291181.description: Assess, and treats persons with hearing and related disorders. Fit hearing aids, and provide auditory training. May pre-form research related to, hearing problems.
49-670291181.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-65.title: Ship Radar Endorsement
00-65.description: The Ship Radar Endorsement is issued by the Federal Communications Commission to licensed commercial radio operators. This endorsement allows them to repair, maintain, or internally adjust ship radar equipment. Passing a written exam is required. For further information, see the FCC web site at http://wireless.fcc.gov/commoperators/sre.html.

49-670395011.title: BARBER
49-670395011.description: Provide services related to head and facial hair; shampoo, cut and style hair, trim beards or give shaves.
49-670395011.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670395012.title: COSMETOLOGIST HAIR STYLIST
49-670395012.description: Cosmetologists - barbers cut, style, and advise patrons on how to care for their hair. They may straighten, permanent wave, or color hair. Give manicures, scalp and facial treatments. Provide makeup analysis, and clean and style wigs and hairpieces.
49-670395012.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670000050.title: ELECTROLOGIST
49-670000050.description: Provide skincare treatments to face and body to enhance an individual’s appearance. Includes electrologists and laser hair removal specialists
49-670000050.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-21.title: FIRST Class Radiotelegraph Operator's Certificate - T1
00-21.description: FIRST Class Radiotelegraph Operator's Certificate (T1) is issued for 5 years and requires one year of relevant experience and passing a written exam. Further information can be found at the FCC web site: http://wireless.fcc.gov/commoperators/#QUAL6M.

00-24.title: General Radiotelephone Operator License - PG
00-24.description: General Radiotelephone Operator License (PG) is issued for a lifetime and requires one year of relevant experience and passing a written exam. For further information, go to the FCC web site: http://wireless.fcc.gov/commoperators/#QUAL6M.

00-26.title: GMDSS Radio Maintainer's License - DM
00-26.description: GMDSS (Global Maritime Distress and Safety System) Radio Maintainer's License (DM) is issued for 5 years and requires one year of relevant experience and passing a written exam. For further information, go to the FCC web site: http://wireless.fcc.gov/commoperators/#QUAL6M.

00-27.title: GMDSS Radio Operator's License - DO
00-27.description: GMDSS (Global Maritime Distress and Safety System) Radio Operator's License (DO) is issued for 5 years and requires one year of relevant experience and passing a written exam. For further information, go to the FCC web site: http://wireless.fcc.gov/commoperators/#QUAL6M.

00-25.title: Marine Radio Operator Permit - MP
00-25.description: Marine Radio Operator Permit (MP) is issued for 5 years and requires one year of relevant experience and passing a written exam. For further information, go to the FCC web site: http://wireless.fcc.gov/commoperators/#QUAL6M.

00-58.title: Radio Officer
00-58.description: The Radio Officer's license is issued to applicants who have a valid Federal Communications Commission (FCC) license as first or second class radiotelegraph operator (T1, T2). Certain officers are required to hold Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) certification issued by the FCC. Further information can be found at theUSCG website http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-58.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-75.title: Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit (RP)
00-75.description: RP holders are authorized to operate most aircraft and aeronautical ground stations. They can also operate marine radiotelephone stations aboard pleasure craft (other than those carrying more than six passengers for hire on the Great Lakes or bays or tidewaters or in the open sea) when operator licensing is required. To obtain this permit, you must be able to speak and hear; and keep a written log; and be familiar with provisions of applicable treaties, laws and rules which govern the radio station you will operate. For further information, see the Federal Communications web site at http://wireless.fcc.gov/commoperators/rp.html.

00-22.title: SECOND Class Radiotelegraph Operator's Certificate - T2
00-22.description: SECOND Class Radiotelegraph Operator's Certificate (T2) is issued for 5 years and requires one year of relevant experience and passing a written exam. For further information, go to the FCC web site: http://wireless.fcc.gov/commoperators/#QUAL6M.

00-23.title: THIRD Class Radiotelegraph Operator's Certificate - T3
00-23.description: THIRD Class Radiotelegraph Operator's Certificate (T3) is issued for 5 years and requires one year of relevant experience and passing a written exam. For further information, go to the FCC web site: http://wireless.fcc.gov/commoperators/#QUAL6M.

00-57.title: Assistant Engineer - Uninspected Fishing Industry Vessels
00-57.description: Requirements to obtain a United States Coast Guard license as an Assistant Engineer - Uninspected Fishing Industry Vessels include 1,080 days at sea with 720 days on Motor Vessels. Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. Further information can be found at the USCG website http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-57.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-56.title: Chief Engineer - Uninspected Fishing Industry Vessels
00-56.description: Requirements to obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a Chief Engineer - Uninspected Fishing Industry Vessels include 1,440 days at sea with 360 days as a Licensed Engineer and 950 days on Motor Vessels. Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm.
00-56.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-19.title: Inspector's Authorization
00-19.description: To obtain an inspector's authorization, a mechanic must have held an Aircraft Mechanic A & P certificate for at least 3 years. For further information, see web site http://www.faa.gov/licenses_certificates/airmen_certification/airmen_FAQ, parts 65.91-65.95.

00-41.title: Operator of Uninspected Passenger Vessels - OUPV
00-41.description: To become licensed as an Operator of Uninspected Passenger Vessels requires specific experience -- Near Coastal or Inland as well as passing a written exam. Recent training in First Aid and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) is also required. For complete details see the USCG web page http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr13_02, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at website http://frwebgate4.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/waisgate.cgi?WAISdocID=50846230377+3+0+0&WAISaction=retrieve or http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-41.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-42.title: Operator of Uninspected Towing Vessels - OUTV
00-42.description: To become licensed as a an Operator of Uninspected Towing Vessels (OUTV) or 2nd Class Operator of Uninspected Towing Vessels (OUTV) requires specific experience - Oceans (Domestic Route), Near Coastal or Inland, as well as passing a written exam. Recent training in First Aid and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) is also required. This license is valid for 5 years and may be renewed through various options involving recent work experience, passing an open-book exercise, or completing a refresher training course. Details can be found on the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-42.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-670474011.title: BUILDING INSPECTOR
49-670474011.description: "Inspector" means a person employed by a local regulator, state regulator or compliance agency for the purpose of inspecting building, electrical, plumbing or mechanical construction, alteration, remodeling, repair or installation in accordance with the codes adopted under these rules and taking appropriate action based upon the findings made during inspection.
49-670474011.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-cdl.title: Commercial Drivers License (CDL)
49-cdl.description: Commercial Drivers Licenses are issued by state departments but are similar from state to state, since the minimum requirements of the licenses and endorsements are set centrally. For more information contact the state DMV or https://cms.fmcsa.dot.gov/registration/commercial-drivers-license/how-do-i-get-commercial-drivers-license.
49-cdl.agency: Utah Department of Public Safety · Driver License Services

49-180533052.title: DRIVER - TRANSIT AND INTERCITY
49-180533052.description: Bus drivers transport passengers over specified routes, to local or distant points, according to time schedule, assist’s passengers with baggage and collects tickets or cash fares, regulates heating, lighting, and ventilating systems for passenger comfort. They comply with local traffic regulations, report delays or accidents. Record cash receipts, and ticket fare. Bus drivers make repairs and change tires. Inspect the bus, check the gas, oil, and water before departure, load or unload baggage or express checked by passengers. Transport pupils between pickup points and school.
49-180533052.agency: Utah Department of Public Saftey · Drivers License Division

49-270399011.title: CHILD CARE PROVIDER
49-270399011.description: Attend to children at schools, businesses, private households, and childcare institutions. Perform a variety of tasks, such as dressing, feeding, bathing, and overseeing play.
49-270399011.agency: Utah Department of Health & Human Services · The Bureau of Child Care Licensing

49-670291011.title: CHIROPRACTIC PHYSICIAN
49-670291011.description: Adjust spinal column and other articulations of the body to correct abnormalities of the human body believed to cause by interference with the nervous system. Examine patient to determine nature and extent of disorder. Manipulate spine or other involved area, may utilize supplementary measures, such as exercise, rest, water, light, heat, and nutritional therapy.
49-670291011.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670172051.title: PROFESSIONAL STRUCTURAL ENGINEER
49-670172051.description: Perform engineering duties in planning, designing, and overseeing construction and maintenance of building structures, and facilities, such as roads, railroads, airports, bridges, harbors, channels, dams, irrigation projects, pipelines, power plants, water and sewage systems, and waste disposal units.
49-670172051.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-690131031.title: INSURANCE ADJUSTER
49-690131031.description: Review settled claims to determine that payments and settlements are made in accordance with company practices and procedures. Confer with legal counsel on claims requiring litigation. May also settle insurance claims.

49-670000074.title: HUNTING GUIDE
49-670000074.description: "Hunting guide" means an individual who offers to guide, lead, or assist another individual in hunting wildlife on public lands for compensation; and is retained for compensation by an outfitter.
49-670000074.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670000090.title: OUTFITTER
49-670000090.description: "Outfitter" means an individual who offers outfitting services for compensation to another individual for hunting wildlife on public lands. "Outfitting services" means providing, for hunting wildlife on public lands: transportation of people, equipment, supplies, or wildlife to or from a location; or packing, protecting, or supervising services.
49-670000090.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670119021.title: CONTRACTOR
49-670119021.description: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of construction or extraction workers. A contractor performs specified construction work in accordance with the architect's plans, the building codes, and so forth by providing materials and/or work.
49-670119021.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670273092.title: COURT REPORTER CERTIFIED
49-670273092.description: Use verbatim methods and equipment to capture, store, retrieve, and transcribe pretrial and trial proceedings or other information.
49-670273092.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-400252032.title: CTE EDUCATION TEACHERS, SECONDARY SCHOOL
49-400252032.description: Teach occupational, vocatinl, career, or technical subjects to students at the secondary school level.
49-400252032.agency: Educator Licensing Division · Utah State Board of Education

49-400252022.title: TEACHERS - ELEMENTARY, MIDDLE, SECONDARY
49-400252022.description: Early childhood, elementary, and secondary education teachers instruct children of preschool age onward in social and academic skills.
49-400252022.agency: Educator Licensing Division · Utah State Board of Education

49-670291292.title: DENTAL HYGIENIST
49-670291292.description: A dental hygienist preserves health and prevents disease of teeth by cleaning and administering X- rays of the teeth, assisting dentist, educating patients, and the public.
49-670291292.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670291021.title: DENTIST
49-670291021.description: A dentist diagnoses and treats disease, injuries, and malformations of teeth, gums, and related oral structures.
49-670291021.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670291031.title: DIETITIAN
49-670291031.description: Plan and conduct food service or nutritional programs to assist in the promotion of health and control of disease. Supervise activities of a department providing quantity food services, counsel individuals, or conduct nutritional research.
49-670291031.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670472111.title: ELECTRICIAN
49-670472111.description: Installs, maintains, and repairs electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures. Ensures that work is in accordance with relevant codes. Install or service street lights, intercom systems, or electrical control systems.
49-670472111.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670474021.title: ELEVATOR MECHANIC
49-670474021.description: Assemble, install, repair, or maintain electric or hydraulic freight or passenger elevators, escalators, or dumbwaiters.
49-670474021.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-271292042.title: EMERGENCY MEDICAL TECHNICIAN
49-271292042.description: Assess injuries, administer emergency medical care, and extricate trapped individuals. Transport injured or sick persons to medical facilities.
49-271292042.agency: Utah Department of Health · The Bureau of Emergency Medical Services

49-670192041.title: ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH SCIENTIST
49-670192041.description: Conducts research or performs investigations for the purpose of identifying, abating or eliminating sources of pollutants or hazards that affect either the environment or the health of the population. Utilizing knowledge of various scientific disciplines may collect, synthesize, study, report, and take action based on data derived from measurements or observations of air, food, soil, water, and other sources.
49-670192041.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670000065.title: ESTHETICIAN
49-670000065.description: Skin care therapists, work at salons, day spas, and medi-spas. Estheticians are trained in the cosmetic treatment of the skin. They perform various cosmetic procedures including facials, body treatments, and waxing. Most estheticians offer a variety of specialty spa treatments.
49-670000065.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-671132052.title: SECURITIES-INVESTMENT ADVISER
49-671132052.description: Securities/investment adviser is any person who, for compensation, engages in the business of advising others, either directly or through publications or writings, as to the value of securities or as to the advisability of investing in, purchasing, or selling securities, or who, for compensation and as part of a regular business, issues or promulgates analyses or reports concerning securities. "'Investment adviser' also includes financial planners and other persons who, as an integral component of other financially related services, provide the foregoing investment advisory services to others for compensation and as part of a business or who hold themselves out as providing the foregoing investment advisory services to others for compensation."
49-671132052.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Utah Division of Securities

00-FinOpL.title: Series 39 - Direct Participation Programs Limited Principal
00-FinOpL.description: Covered supervisory activities and products include regulatory compliance over sales of: ?Direct participation program limited partnerships (e.g., real estate, oil and gas, and equipment leasing) ?Limited liability companies ?S corporations In addition to sales supervision, the Series 39 qualifies a principal for the overall supervision of a firm’s investment banking and securities business—including compliance, underwriting and advertising—for those activities specially covered by each supervisory principal’s license.

49-670194092.title: DECEPTION DETECTION EXAMINER
49-670194092.description: An individual who is engages in or represents that the individual is engaged in conducting or performing deception detection examinations or in the interpretation of deception detection examination.
49-670194092.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670119171.title: FUNERAL SERVICE DIRECTOR
49-670119171.description: A funeral service director prepares body for interment by treating with chemicals in conformity with legal requirements, directs, and arranges funeral and other necessary services for the deceased.
49-670119171.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670299092.title: GENETIC COUNSELOR
49-670299092.description: "Practice of genetic counseling" means the communication process, which deals with the human problems associated with the occurrence, or the risk of occurrence, of a genetic disorder in a family, including the provision of services to help an individual or family. Comprehend the medical facts, including the diagnosis, probable cause of the disorder, and the available management. Appreciate the way heredity contributes to the disorder and the risk of occurrence in specified relatives; understand the alternatives for dealing with the risk of occurrence, choose the course of action which seems appropriate to them in view of their risk, their family goals, and their ethical and religious standards, and to act in accordance with that decision. Make the best possible psychosocial adjustment to the disorder in an affected family member or to the risk of occurrence of that disorder.
49-670299092.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670172151.title: GEOLOGIST
49-670172151.description: Study composition, structure, and history of the earth's crust; examine rocks, minerals, and fossil remains to identify and determine the sequence of processes affecting the development of the earth; apply knowledge of chemistry, physics, biology, and mathematics to explain these phenomena and to help locate mineral and petroleum deposits and underground water resources; prepare geologic reports and maps; and interpret research data to recommend further action for study.
49-670172151.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670299099.title: DIRECT ENTRY MIDWIFE
49-670299099.description: “Direct-entry midwifery" means practice of providing the necessary supervision, care, and advice to a client during essentially normal pregnancy, labor, delivery, postpartum, and newborn periods that is consistent with national professional midwifery standards and that is based upon the acquisition of clinical skills necessary for the care of pregnant women and newborns, including ante-partum, intra-partum, postpartum, newborn, and limited inter-conceptual care.
49-670299099.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670291161.title: NURSE MIDWIFE
49-670291161.description: Independent management of women's health care, focusing particularly on pregnancy, childbirth, and the postpartum period, care of the newborn, and the family planning and gynecological needs of women.
49-670291161.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670119111.title: HEALTH FACILITY ADMINISTRATOR
49-670119111.description: "Administrator" means a person who is charged with the general administration of a health facility. Plan, direct, or coordinate medicine and health services in hospitals, clinics, managed care organizations, public health agencies, or similar organizations.
49-670119111.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-swn75.title: Certified Social Worker
49-swn75.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-swn74.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
49-swn74.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670211021.title: SOCIAL SERVICE WORKER
49-670211021.description: Social service workers apply their training and experience in a variety of settings such as counseling individuals, working to strengthen personal and family relationships, and helping clients to cope with problems. Social service aides work under the close guidance and supervision of professional staff.
49-670211021.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670292092.title: HEARING INSTRUMENT SPECIALIST
49-670292092.description: A hearing instrument specialist specializes in dispensing or fitting hearing aids, tests customers hearing, confers with customers concerning particular hearing needs, demonstrating use of aid to customers, fitting or sizing hearing aids, replacing defective parts or making repairs to equipment returned by customers.
49-670292092.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-Ins.title: NIPR Insurance Registry
00-Ins.description: Licensed Insurance Occupations must also be registered at the federal level.

49-690413021.title: INSURANCE AGENTS & BROKERS
49-690413021.description: Sell life, property, casualty, health, automotive, or other types of insurance. May refer clients to independent brokers, work as independent broker, or be employed by an insurance company.

49-670271025.title: COMMERCIAL INTERIOR DESIGNER
49-670271025.description: Assess the needs of clients with commercial space and recommend fabrics, accessories, furniture and other design elements that can be combined to suit the clients' needs. They may focus on everything from building structure to furniture and accessories.
49-670271025.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670273091.title: MEDICAL LANGUAGE INTERPRETER
49-670273091.description: Serves as a translator between a patient and a doctor to alleviate language barriers. Help the physician understand the history and physical information from the patient, as well as the symptoms and reason for the patient’s visit. Translate the physician’s questions and answers for the patient to understand and respond when necessary.
49-670273091.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670193033.title: PSYCHOLOGIST
49-670193033.description: A psychologist deals directly with individuals and groups to promote development of their potential or to correct personality disturbances. The psychologist interviews, administers, and interprets tests. Also studies case files, and evaluates data.
49-670193033.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670171012.title: LANDSCAPE ARCHITECT
49-670171012.description: A landscape architect provides professional services for the purpose of landscape preservation, development, or enhancement.
49-670171012.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-BAR000108.title: ATTORNEY / LAWYERS
49-BAR000108.description: Represent clients in criminal and civil litigation and other legal proceedings, draw up legal documents, or manage or advise clients on legal transactions. May specialize in a single area or may practice broadly in many areas of law.

49-672132072.title: RESIDENTIAL MORTGAGE LENDER
49-672132072.description: Residential mortgage lender originates a residential mortgage loan directed to or received in the State of Utah, directly or indirectly solicit, process, place, or negotiate such a mortgage loan, or render services related to the origination, processing, or funding of such a mortgage loan, including taking applications, obtaining verifications and appraisals, and communicating with the borrower and lender.
49-672132072.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Utah Division of Real Estate

49-670292061.title: LICENSED PRACTICAL NURSE
49-670292061.description: Assess patient health problems and needs, develop and implement nursing care plans, and maintain medical records. Administer nursing care to ill, injured, convalescent, or disabled patients. Include advance practice nurses who have specialized formal, post-basic education and who function in highly autonomous and specialized roles.
49-670292061.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670499071.title: HANDYMAN
49-670499071.description: Fix and maintain machines, mechanical equipment, and buildings. They paint, repair flooring, and work on plumbing, electrical, and air-conditioning and heating systems.
49-670499071.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670395092.title: NAIL TECHNICIAN
49-670395092.description: Nail Technicians may clean, and shape customers' fingernails and toenails, polish or decorate nails.
49-670395092.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670211013.title: MARRIAGE - FAMILY THERAPIST
49-670211013.description: A marriage and family therapist advises individuals and families having family or other social problems.
49-670211013.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670319011.title: MASSAGE THERAPIST
49-670319011.description: A massage therapist practices, or administers the techniques of body massage, either by hands or with a mechanical or electrical apparatus, for the purpose of body massaging, reducing or contouring, which may include, the use of oil rubs, heat lamps, salt glows, hot and cold packs, tub, shower, steam or cabinet baths.
49-670319011.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-52.title: Assistant Engineer (Limited - Oceans)
00-52.description: Requirements to obtain a United States Coast Guard license as an Assistant Engineer (Limited - Oceans) include 1,080 days at sea, with 540 days as a Qualified Member of the Engine Department (QMED). Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-52.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-47.title: First Assistant Engineer - Upper Level
00-47.description: To obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a First Assistant Engineer - Upper Level, the applicant must complete 360 days of service as a Second or Third Assistant Engineer; while holding a Second Assistant Engineer license. Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. This license is valid for 5 years and may be renewed through various options involving recent work experience, passing an open-book exercise, or completing a refresher training course. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations
00-47.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-49.title: Third Assistant Engineer - Upper Level
00-49.description: To obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a Third Assistant Engineer (upper Level, the applicant must complete one of the following: 1080 days of service in the engine room with 720 days as a Qualified Member of the Engine Department (QMED); or 1080 days as a machinist apprentice engaged in construction or repair of marine, locomotive, or stationary engines plus 360 days of sea service in an engine room as oiler, watertender, or jr. engineer; or graduate from an approved course of studies. This license is valid for 5 years and may be renewed through various options involving recent work experience, passing an open-book exercise, or completing a refresher training course. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-49.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-670291126.title: RESPIRATORY CARE PRACTITIONER
49-670291126.description: A respiratory care practitioner's duties may include operation of equipment, management, diagnostic testing, care of any human disease, deficiency, pain, injury, or other physical condition associated with the cardiopulmonary system under the qualified medical direction or supervision in diagnosis, treatment, and assessment of respiratory problems.
49-670291126.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-10.title: Nuclear Facility Operator
00-10.description: Nuclear Facility Operators are required to have either training or experience to become licensed. They must pass a medical exam, a written test, and an operating test. Although the license is granted for 6 years, licensees must pass another medical exam every two years and an operating test annually. Also, they must undergo requalification training while employed. Nuclear Facility Senior Operators have additional experience and pass another exam to be promoted from Nuclear Facility Operators. Further information can be found at the web site: http://www.nrc.gov/reactors/operator-licensing.html

49-670291151.title: NURSE ANESTHETIST
49-670291151.description: A nurse who specializes in the administration of anesthesia. a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA) is an advanced practice registered nurse (APRN) who has acquired graduate-level education and board certification in anesthesia. Their anesthesia practice consists of all accepted anesthetic techniques including general, epidural, spinal, peripheral nerve block, sedation, or local.
49-670291151.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-63.title: Hospital Corpsman
00-63.description: A Hospital Corpsman is a staff officer and is required to obtain a Certificate of Registry (COR). To obtain a COR requires completing first aid and cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training within the past 12 months and meeting medical fitness standards. A hospital corpsman must have U.S. military experience as and a rating of hospital corpsman or Health Services Technician or equivalent. Further information can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, http://frwebgate.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/get-cfr.cgi?TITLE=46&PART=10&SUBPART=H&TYPE=TEXT, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-63.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-670291122.title: OCCUPATIONAL THERAPIST
49-670291122.description: An occupational therapist plans, and directs educational, vocational, and recreational activities designed to help mentally, physically, or emotionally disabled patients become self-sufficient. Occupational therapy assistants work under the supervision of professional occupational therapists.
49-670291122.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670291041.title: OPTOMETRIST
49-670291041.description: An optometrist examines eyes to determine visual defects or diseases and prescribes corrective procedures.
49-670291041.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670312011.title: OCCUPATIONAL THERAPIST ASSISTANT
49-670312011.description: Occupational therapy assistants work under the supervision of professional occupational therapists. Helping develop treatment plans and administer therapy to patients.
49-670312011.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670291051.title: PHARMACIST
49-670291051.description: A pharmacist, and pharmacy intern compounds and dispenses medications, following prescriptions issued by physician, dentist, or other authorized medical practitioner.
49-670291051.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670292052.title: PHARMACY TECHNICIANS
49-670292052.description: A pharmacist, and pharmacy intern compounds and dispenses medications, following prescriptions issued by physician, dentist, or other authorized medical practitioner.
49-670292052.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670291123.title: PHYSICAL THERAPISTS
49-670291123.description: A physical therapist plans and administers medically prescribed physical therapy treatment programs for patients to relieve pain, restore function, and prevent disability.
49-670291123.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-80.title: Marine Physician Assistant
00-80.description: A Marine Physician Assistant is a staff officer and is required to obtain a Certificate of Registry (COR). To obtain a COR requires completing first aid and cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training within the past 12 months and meeting medical fitness standards. A physician assistant must also have training as a physician's assistant or nurse practitioner. Further information can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, http://frwebgate.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/get-cfr.cgi?TITLE=46&PART=10&SUBPART=H&TYPE=TEXT, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-80.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-670291071.title: PHYSICIAN ASSISTANT
49-670291071.description: A physician assistant diagnoses, treats, advises, and prescribes for human diseases or injuries under the supervision of a licensed physician and in accordance with a utilization plan.
49-670291071.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-31.title: Tankerman
00-31.description: Tankerman refers to several endorsements or qualified ratings to Merchant Marine Documents (MMD). All Tankerman endorsements require qualifying experience, training in firefighting and cargo (dangerous liquids or liquefied gasses), and passing an exam. Endorsements include Tankerman - Person-In-Charge (Tankerman PIC), Tankerman-Engineer, Tankerman Assistant, and Tankerman - PIC (Barge). Tankerman endorsements are valid for the duration of the MMD, which is issued for 5 years. Renewal of certification requires meeting all the requirements to renew the MMD and either have recent qualifying experience or training. Further information can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46 CFR13.109) at website http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr13_02.html.
00-31.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-670472152.title: PLUMBERS
49-670472152.description: Plumbers install, maintain, alter, and repair piping systems that carry water, steam, air, or other liquids or gases, install and maintain plumbing fixtures, appliances, and heating, air conditioning, and refrigeration equipment.
49-670472152.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670291081.title: PODIATRIC PHYSICIAN
49-670291081.description: A podiatrist diagnoses and treats conditions affecting the human foot, and ankle and their manifestations, or deformities of the human foot
49-670291081.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670211092.title: PROBATION PROVIDER
49-670211092.description: A private probation provider prepares pre-sentence investigation reports or provides probation supervision for individuals who commit minor offenses and misdemeanor violations.
49-670211092.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-05.title: Customs Broker
00-05.description: Customs brokers must pass an exam to obtain a license. Further information can be found at the US Customs Service web site: http://www.customs.gov/xp/cgov/import/broker_management/.

00-59.title: Purser
00-59.description: The Purser, one of a ship's staff officers, is required to obtain a Certificate of Registry (COR). To obtain a COR requires completing first aid and cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training within the past 12 months and meeting medical fitness standards. A Junior Assistant Purser requires no experience. A Senior Assistant Purser requires 180 days, a Purser requires 360 days, and a Chief Purser requires 720 days of service aboard vessels while performing duties related to the purser's office. Further information can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, http://frwebgate.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/get-cfr.cgi?TITLE=46&PART=10&SUBPART=H&TYPE=TEXT, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-59.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-670312021.title: PHYSICAL THERAPIST ASSISTANT
49-670312021.description: Assists physical therapists in administering treatment programs meant to relieve pain, restore function, and prevent physical disability in patients.
49-670312021.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670319092.title: RADIOLOGY ASSISTANT
49-670319092.description: A radiology technician and technologist assistant use radiation from a radioactive substance, radiology equipment, or any other source, in amounts beyond normal background levels, for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes on humans; works under the supervision of a radiology practitioner.
49-670319092.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-670292034.title: RADIOLOGY TECHNOLOGIST
49-670292034.description: A radiology technician and technologist use radiation from a radioactive substance, radiology equipment, or any other source, in amounts beyond normal background levels, for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes on humans; works under the supervision of a radiology practitioner.
49-670292034.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-672419022.title: REAL ESTATE SALES AGENT
49-672419022.description: Rent, buy, or sell property for clients. Perform duties such as study property listings, interview prospective clients, accompany clients to property site, discuss conditions of sale, and draw up real estate contracts. Includes agents who represent buyer.
49-672419022.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Utah Division of Real Estate

49-672419021.title: REAL ESTATE BROKER
49-672419021.description: Operate real estate office, or work for commercial real estate firm, overseeing real estate transactions. Other duties usually include selling real estate or renting properties and arranging loans.
49-672419021.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Utah Division of Real Estate

49-670291125.title: RECREATIONAL THERAPIST
49-670291125.description: A recreational therapist plans organizes, directs or coordinates medically-approved recreation programs for patients in hospitals, nursing homes or other institutions. May assess patient condition and recommend appropriate recreational activity.
49-670291125.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

49-120412031.title: MOTOR VEHICLE DEALERS & SALESPERSON
49-120412031.description: A motor vehicle salesperson and dealers sell used and new automobiles. This includes explaining features, demonstrating the operation of the car, and suggesting optional equipment. Computing and quoting the sales price including tax, trade in allowance, license fee, and discounts. Helping customers with the requirements of buying a car on credit.
49-120412031.agency: Utah State Tax Commission · Motor Vechile Enforcement Division

00-61.title: Professional Nurse
00-61.description: A ship's Professional Nurse is a staff officer and is required to obtain a Certificate of Registry (COR). To obtain a COR requires completing first aid and cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training within the past 12 months and meeting medical fitness standards. A professional nurse must also hold a valid license as a registered nurse issued within the United States. Further information can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, http://frwebgate.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/get-cfr.cgi?TITLE=46&PART=10&SUBPART=H&TYPE=TEXT, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-61.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-670291141.title: REGISTERED NURSE
49-670291141.description: Assess patient health problems and needs, develop and implement nursing care plans, and maintain medical records. Administer nursing care to ill, injured, convalescent, or disabled patients. Include advance practice nurses who have specialized formal, post-basic education and who function in highly autonomous and specialized roles.
49-670291141.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-03.title: Able Seaman - AB
00-03.description: Requirements for an Able Seaman license include a medical certificate of excellent health, and a certificate attesting to vision, color perception, and general physical condition. While no experience or formal schooling is required, training at a union-operated school is the best source. With experience at sea, and perhaps union-sponsored training, an ordinary seaman with a Merchant Marine Document (MMD) can pass the Able Seaman exam and move up with 3 years of service. Please see the U.S. Coast Guard web site at: http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, the Veteran's Employment and Training Service (VETS) web site at http://umet-vets.dol.gov/ableseaman.htm, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46 CFR12.02-11) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr12_02.html
00-03.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-30.title: Lifeboatman - LBMAN
00-30.description: A person with a Merchant Marine Document (MMD) with one year of experience at sea in the deck department, two years experience in any other department on vessels greater than 100 gross tons, or who has completed a USCG approved course and 3 months of sea experience may take written and practical exams to be endorsed with the qualified rating of Lifeboatman (LB). An MMD with a qualified rating is valid for 5 years and may be renewed through documented recent experience, pass an exam, or complete a training course. Further information can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR12.10-7) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr12_02.html.
00-30.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-33.title: Merchant Mariner's Document - MMD
00-33.description: The United States Coast Guard issues a Merchant Mariner's Document (MMD) to unlicensed personnel who support the operation of a vessel. Unqualified ratings are issued to entry level individuals who typically have little or no sea service for the following rating types: ordinary seaman (deck department), wiper (engineering department), or food handler (steward's department). Qualified ratings are issued based on previous sea service in a particular department or specialized training. Qualified ratings for members in the deck department are issued by rating type (e.g. Able Seaman) and vessel type restrictions (e.g. sail vessels or offshore supply vessels). Qualified ratings for members in the engineering department are issued by type (e.g. Qualified Member of the Engine Department) and specific rating (e.g. oiler, fireman/watertender, junior engineer, deck engine mechanic, or engineman). Other ratings are issued for specialized training or experience, such as Lifeboatman, Tankerman, or GMDSS At-Sea Maintainer. An MMD is valid for 5 years and may be renewed. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46 CFR12.02-11) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr12_02.html.
00-33.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-04.title: Ordinary Seaman
00-04.description: An Ordinary Seaman is a person holding a Merchant Mariner's Document (MMD) issued by the United States Coast Guard without qualified ratings. This is an entry level MMD and does not require maritime experience or a physical examination, but will require proof that the applicant has passed a chemical test for dangerous drugs. While no training is required, a union-operated school can provide useful background knowledge. An MMD is valid for 5 years and may be renewed. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46 CFR12.02-11) at website http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr12_02.html.
00-04.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-32.title: Qualified Member of the Engine Department - QMED
00-32.description: Qualified Member of the Engine Department - QMED A person with a Merchant Mariner's Document (MMD) having at least 6 months of underway service working as a wiper or coal passer in the engineering department may take a written exam and at least one rating exam (Fireman/Watertender, Oiler, Deck Engineer, Junior Engineer, Refrigeration Engineer, Electrician, Machinist, or Pumpman) to be endorsed as a Qualified Member of the Engine Department (QMED). Additional experience is required for some endorsements. Renewal of certification requires meeting all the requirements to renew the MMD and either have recent qualifying experience or training. Further information can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46 CFR12.15-11) at website http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr12_02.html.
00-32.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-400119032.title: EDUCATION ADMINISTRATORS, KINDERGARTEN THROUGH SECONDARY
49-400119032.description: Plan, direct, or coordinate the academic, administrative, or auxiliary activities of kindergarten, elementary, or secondary schools.

49-180533051.title: DRIVER - SCHOOL BUS

49-671000099.description: Securities agent is defined as an individual other than a broker-dealer who represents a broker-dealer or issuer in effecting or attempting to effect purchases or sales of securities.

49-671000100.title: SECURITIES – BROKER – DEALER
49-671000100.description: Securities/Broker-Agent is any person engaged in the business of effecting transactions in securities, buy and sell securities in investment and trading firms, or call upon businesses and individuals to sell financial services. 49-671000100.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Utah Division of Securities

49-670339032.title: SECURITY GUARD
49-670339032.description: A security guard will guard, patrol, and inspect property to protect it against fire, theft, vandalism, and illegal entry. Specific duties vary with size, type, and location of employer. A security guard may or may not carry a firearm.
49-670339032.agency: Utah Department of Commerece · Division of Occupational & Professional Licensing

00-28.title: Ocean Transportation Intermediary - OTI
00-28.description: Licensure as an Ocean Transportation Intermediary (OTI) - Ocean Freight Forwarder requires that the designated employee for the company have three years of qualifying experience, meet character requirements, and be bonded. The license is issued indefinitely or until revoked or suspended. Details can be found at the FMC web sites http://www.fmc.gov/cfr/515.htm, http://www.fmc.gov/Help/OTI.htm, and the Code of Federal Regulations (46CFR515) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr515_02.html.
00-28.agency: Federal Maritime Commission · Bureau of Tariffs, Certification and Licensing

00-29.title: Ocean Transportation Intermediary -NVOCC
00-29.description: Licensure as an Ocean Transportation Intermediary (OTI)- Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) requires that the qualifying individual for the company have three years of qualifying experience, meet character requirements, and be bonded. The license is issued indefinitely or until revoked or suspended. Details can be found at the FMC web sites: http://www.fmc.gov/cfr/515.htm, http://www.fmc.gov/Help/OTI.htm, and the Code of Federal Regulations (46CFR515) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr515_02.html.
00-29.agency: Federal Maritime Commission · Bureau of Tariffs, Certification and Licensing

00-67.title: Barge Supervisor
00-67.description: A Barge Supervisor is required to pass an exam, have 3 years of related work experience or an approved degree in engineering or engineering technology, plus at least 168 days of related experience. Specialized training is also required in stability of the mobile offshore drilling unit (ODU), survival at sea, and firefighting. Federal regulations can be found at the web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-67.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-37.title: Chief Mate - Upper Level
00-37.description: To obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a Chief Mate - Upper Level requires 360 days service as Officer in Charge of a Navigational Watch (OIC) on Any Gross Tons oceangoing steam or motor vessels while licensed as a Second Mate. Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. More information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-37.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-34.title: Deck Officers
00-34.description: The navigation of a vessel and management of the deck department is the responsibility of the Deck Officers. Deck officers' licenses are issued by grade (e.g., Master, Chief Mate, Second Mate, Third Mate, Mate and Operator), any vessel type restrictions (e.g. Uninspected Fishing Industry or Uninspected Passenger vessels), means of propulsion (Steam, Motor, Sail or Auxiliary Sail), vessel tonnage (from not more than 5 to any gross register tons), and route (e.g., Inland, Great Lakes, Near Coastal or Oceans). Further information can be found at the United States Coast Guard website http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-34.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-40.title: Master - Lower Level
00-40.description: Obtaining a United States Coast Guard license as a Master - Lower Level requires a specified amount of qualifying service based on details such as vessel size and area of operation (ocean, near coastal, Great Lakes, or inland). Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. This license is valid for 5 years and may be renewed through various options involving recent work experience, passing an open-book exercise, or completing a refresher training course. Detailed information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-40.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-36.title: Master - Upper Level
00-36.description: To obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a Master - Upper Level requires 360 days service as Chief Mate on ocean Any Gross Tons steam or motor vessels; or 180 days as Chief Mate plus 360 days as Officer in Charge of a Navigational Watch (OIC). Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. Detailed information can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-36.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-66.title: Offshore Installation Manager - OIM
00-66.description: An Offshore Installation Manager (OIM) requires passing an exam and four years of related work experience or an approved degree in engineering or engineering technology and at least 168 days of related work experience. Specialized training in rig stability, oil well control or operation, firefighting and survival at sea are required. OIMs apply for an OIM Unrestricted License or one of four specialized licenses: OIM Surface Units on Location, OIM Surface Units Underway, OIM Bottom Bearing Units Underway, and OIM Bottom-Bearing Units on Location. Federal regulations can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, http://frwebgate.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/get-cfr.cgi?TITLE=46&PART=10&SECTION=470&YEAR=1999&TYPE=TEXT, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-66.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-44.title: Pilot (Ship)
00-44.description: A license or endorsement as a Pilot is route-specific and requires experience navigating the body of water specified. A written exam and physical exam are also required. Further information on Pilot requirements can be found on the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at https://www.govinfo.gov/app/details/CFR-2002-title46-vol1/CFR-2002-title46-vol1-part10.
00-44.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-69.title: Radar Observer
00-69.description: The Radar Observer certificate is issued by the United States Coast Guard to licensed deck officers. It requires specialized training and examination in radar navigation and is issued for 5 years. Further information can be found in the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10.305) at web site http://frwebgate4.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/waisgate.cgi?WAISdocID=50176913269+4+2+0&WAISaction=retrieve and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-69.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-39.title: Third Mate - Upper Level
00-39.description: To obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a Third Mate - Upper Level requires 1080 days service in the deck department of ocean steam or motor vessels with 6 months as Able Seaman (AB); or graduate from an approved marine academy; or completion of an approved 3 year apprentice mate training program; or 360 days as Master on ocean steam or motor vessels greater than 200 GT while licensed as a Master 1600 Gross Tons. Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. More information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-39.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-68.title: Ballast Control Operator
00-68.description: A United States Coast Guard Ballast Control Operator is required to pass an exam and to have 1 year related experience, including at least 28 days as a trainee under a licensed Ballast Control Operator or a degree in engineering or engineering technology and at least 28 days as a trainee. Specialized training is also required in stability of the mobile offshore drilling unit (ODU), survival at sea, and firefighting. Federal regulations can be found at the web site http://frwebgate2.access.gpo.gov/cgi-bin/waisgate.cgi?WAISdocID=051618583+1+0+0&WAISaction=retrieve, http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-68.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-46.title: Chief Engineer
00-46.description: To be licensed by the United States Coast Guard as a Chief Engineer, the applicant must complete 360 days of service as a First Assistant Engineer; or while holding a First Assistant Engineer license, complete 360 days of service as follows: a minimum of 180 days of service as a First Assistant Engineer plus a minimum of 360 days as a Second or Third Assistant Engineer, Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. This license is valid for 5 years and may be renewed through various options involving recent work experience, passing an open-book exercise, or completing a refresher training course. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-46.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-51.title: Chief Engineer (Limited - Near Coastal)
00-51.description: Requirements to obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a Chief Engineer (Limited - Near Coastal) include 1,440 days at sea, with 360 days as a Licensed Engineer & 720 days as a Qualified Member of the Engine Department (QMED). Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-51.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-50.title: Chief Engineer (Limited - Oceans)
00-50.description: Requirements to obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a Chief Engineer (Limited - Oceans), include 1,800 days at sea, with 720 days as a Licensed Engineer & 900 days as a Qualified Member of the Engine Department (QMED). Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. This license is valid for 5 years and may be renewed through various options involving recent work experience, passing an open-book exercise, or completing a refresher training course. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-50.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-53.title: Designated Duty Engineer
00-53.description: Requirements to obtain a United States Coast Guard license as a Designated Duty Engineer include specified service time at sea, with experience as a Qualified Member of the Engine Department (QMED) on a vessel of specified horsepower. Other requirements include passing a written exam, a physical exam, and completion of a first aid course and a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) course within the past 12 months. Further information can be found at the USCG web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-53.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

00-45.title: Engineering Officers
00-45.description: The propulsion plant of a vessel and management of the engineering department is the responsibility of the Engineering Officers. Engineering officers' licenses are issued by grade (e.g., Chief Engineer, First Assistant Engineer, Second Assistant Engineer, Third Assistant Engineer, Assistant Engineer and Designated Duty Engineer), any vessel type restrictions (e.g. Uninspected Fishing Industry Vessels or Uninspected Passenger vessels), means of propulsion (Steam or Motor), horsepower (from 1,000 to any horsepower), and route (e.g., Near Coastal or Oceans). License limitations for deck and engineering officers, including tonnage and horsepower, are based on the type of experience of each applicant and the passing of applicable written examinations. Each license has separate general, service and examination requirements. Further information can be found at the United States Coast Guard web site http://www.uscg.mil/stcw/index.htm, and the Federal Code of Regulations (46CFR10) at http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/waisidx_02/46cfr10_02.html.
00-45.agency: United States Coast Guard National Maritime Center

49-670171022.title: LAND SURVEYOR
49-670171022.description: A land surveyor establishes land boundaries, researches deeds, writes descriptions of land to satisfy legal requirements. 00-64.title: Enrolled Agent - EA
00-64.description: Requirements to become an enrolled agent of the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) are one of the following (1) pass an exam; or (2) document 5 years of relevant experience as an employee for the IRS. Continuing professional education hours every three-year cycle is required for renewal of the credential. Further information can be found at the IRS web site: http://www.irs.gov/taxpros/agents/index.html.
00-64.agency: Internal Revenue Service · Enrolled Practitioner Program Unit

49-180533053.title: DRIVER – TAXI CAB & CHAUFFEURS
49-180533053.description: Taxi drivers transport passengers for a fee, pick up passengers in response to radio or telephone request for their services, collect a fee based on mileage or time factors and must record each transaction in a log. Taxi drivers may drive a limousine, or van to transport airport passengers to their destinations.

00-79.title: Aircraft Dispatcher
00-79.description: An Aircraft Dispatcher certificate requires that the individual has work experience as an aircraft dispatcher or related occupation such as pilot. Training in aircraft dispatching and passing written and practical tests are also required. This certificate is valid until it is surrendered, suspended or revoked. Detailed information can be found on the web site http://www.access.gpo.gov/nara/cfr/cfrhtml_00/Title_14/14cfr65_00.html, parts 65.51-65.70, and http://www.faa.gov/licenses_certificates/airmen_certification/airmen_FAQ

49-180533032.title: DRIVER - HEAVY TRUCK & TRACTOR TRAILER
49-180533032.description: Truck drivers drive tractor-trailer trucks or operate other forms of heavy trucks to carry goods between terminals. Some drivers deliver a load to a nearby city, pick up another loaded trainer, and return it to their home base the same day, others make runs that take days to complete. On very long trips, they may work with a partner, taking turns driving. Some truck drivers have regular runs, and others have schedules that change from trip to trip. Heavy truck drivers drive single-body trucks that carry materials that weigh three tons or more. This type of truck includes dump, tow, flatbed, ready mix, and tank trucks. Some of the trucks are mounted with special equipment.
49-180533032.agency: Utah Department of Public Saftey · Drivers License Division

49-670291131.title: VETERINARIAN

49-watercert.title: Water Operator Certification
